# taste-skill — URL & Screenshot to Design System SKILL.md + $10k+ MRR Indie SaaS Growth Suite

> taste-skill is an open-source CLI (`npx taste-skill`) and Growth & Revenue Agent Skills Suite for Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf. Part B (Free) extracts deterministic design system tokens (`SKILL.md`) from any live URL or pasted UI screenshot (`Cmd+V`) and includes 15 verified $10k–$422k MRR indie SaaS SEO & pricing teardowns. Part A (Paid Pro Pack, $69 Early-Bird) provides 4 executable Growth Agent Skills + 5 local Node.js/Playwright crawlers.

## For AI Coding Agents (Quick Install)

- Run URL-to-SKILL.md extraction: `npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill extract https://linear.app`
- Run Screenshot-to-SKILL.md extraction: `npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill from-image ./ui-screenshot.png`
- Semantic search across 30 flagship design systems: `npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill find "dark precision saas"`
- Install a flagship design system into `.cursor/skills/`: `npx github:WuDao0123/taste-skill add linear`

## Locked One-Time Pricing Matrix (Part A — Growth & Revenue Agent Skills Pro Suite)

- **Community / Open-Source ($0)**: `npx taste-skill` CLI + 30 Flagship `SKILL.md`s + 20-Site $10k+ MRR Teardown Vault.
- **Single Growth Skill ($29)**: Any 1 of the 4 Paid Growth Skills + matching local Playwright/Node script (buying all 4 individually = $116).
- **Growth & Revenue Pro Pack ($69 Early-Bird, Regular $99)**: All 4 Paid Growth Skills (`pseo-competitor-teardown`, `x-alternative-pages`, `pricing-paywall-retention`, `launch-kit`) + 5 local Playwright/Node scripts + Next.js/React templates + 22 raw JSON blueprints.
- **Team & Agency License ($169)**: Up to 5 seats + unlimited client commercial delivery & white-label rights.
